changelog: - **Export names the real reason when a diagram cannot become a Project revision.** A diagram holding a node of a kind Loop Studio does not know — possible only through a hand-edited file — made File → Export → Project revision say that the browser has no secure random source, which was not the cause, and made Make a proposal do nothing at all. Both now say which node it is and what kind it carries, in words that fit either action. The no-secure-random message stays for that cause only. While such a node is in an open project, the project counts as changed since its last export instead of showing as unchanged.
